title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic ships beta Usage and Cost Analytics API for organization token usage and cost (Oct 29)
bullets.summary: Claude Developer Platform release notes list a beta API exposing org-level token usage and cost; the same feed notes Messages/Token Counting request limits raised from 32 MB to 128 MB (Oct 28).
bullets.how: The Construct: pull our own per-agent/per-routine token spend into the dashboard instead of eyeballing invoices; the 128 MB limit helps image/PDF-heavy runs. PRAGMA: cost-governance reporting for client deployments. Brand 9 Signs: indirect (cheaper art/QC agents).

bullets.title: Anthropic guide: when to fold subagents back into the main agent loop (Oct 22) + Claude Duet proactive-agent research preview (Oct 23)
bullets.summary: Anthropic published architecture guidance on collapsing subagents into a single loop, and a safety/privacy write-up for Claude Duet, a research-preview proactive agent (secondary summary via Releasebot; slightly older than 24h).
bullets.how: The Construct: sanity-check our swarm/worker topology against Anthropic's own guidance — fewer subagents may be cheaper and more reliable. PRAGMA: reference architecture for client agent builds. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Northstar Security launches with $7M seed and exposes its security context graph to AI agents via MCP (Nov 2)
bullets.summary: FinTech Global reports Wing VC-led $7M seed; platform offers a 'Security Context Graph' with 70+ integrations (AWS, Okta, GitHub, Slack, etc.) that external agents such as Claude can query through MCP. Funding figure is single-source.
bullets.how: The Construct: example of 'MCP as the product surface' — worth modelling for our own internal servers. PRAGMA: possible security-posture tool for client engagements once verified. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Google Gemini 4 Carbon announced with cybersecurity focus and phased, defenders-first rollout (Oct 28)
bullets.summary: Coverage describes Google's new flagship with strong benchmarks but access initially limited to cyber defenders (headline-level reading only; article body not retrieved).
bullets.how: The Construct: no access now; track general availability and API pricing before benchmarking against Claude workers. PRAGMA: another sign frontier models gate access by vetting. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Cost and architecture visibility is now first-party: Anthropic ships usage/cost APIs and guidance to collapse subagents, so the Construct should measure per-agent spend and prune topology before adding more workers. (Quiet day: few primary-source items in the last 24h; no new MCP servers in video/CRM/DAM/signage verified.)
